action: Initiated application implementation for request: "Build a fully working ATS Resume Scanner web application. REQUIREMENTS: (1) Real PDF and DOCX resume upload using react-dropzone - the file handler must use FileReader or pdfjs-dist to extract text from the uploaded file. (2) Real ATS score calculation: extract keywords from the resume text, count matches against the job description, and compute a percentage - the score MUST change based on what is uploaded. (3) Real job description text area where the user pastes a job posting. (4) Keyword matching: show which keywords from the job description are found vs missing in the resume. (5) Score breakdown chart using Recharts reading from real computed state - categories: Keywords, Skills, Experience, Education, Formatting. (6) Recommendations list derived from the actual analysis. (7) Scan history saved to localStorage - each entry stores filename, score, date. (8) Export analysis as PDF using jsPDF or window.print. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: hardcoded scores, Math.random() metrics, setTimeout fake loading, static chart arrays. Use React with Vite, Tailwind CSS, dark theme."
Completed requirements mapping. Framework: website, Database: None
